**Customer Outcomes and Feedback:**

* Stay professional and measured on contested and declined claims.
* Flag repeat claimants, unusual merchant activity, and emerging patterns that the current procedure does not account for.
* Raise errors, gaps, and ambiguity in the procedure to the Team Leader, with a view on what the rule should be.

description:
**Travel & Lifestyle Consultant – Luxury Concierge Desk**
**Company:**
Reward360 Global Services (R360)
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai (on-site)
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 years in customer-facing roles in hospitality or travel
  
  
**Shifts:**
Rotational, 24x7 desk (including nights, weekends and public holidays)
  
  
**About The Role**
R360 runs the concierge and rewards desk for the super-premium credit card customers of one of India's leading private-sector banks. These are HNI and ultra-HNI members who expect a five-star-hotel standard of service on every call, email and chat.
  
  
As a Travel & Lifestyle Consultant, you will plan and book complex travel, secure hard-to-get reservations and experiences, and make every reward redemption feel effortless. You own each request from first contact to confirmed fulfilment, and you anticipate what the member will need next.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Luxury and complex travel**

* Plan and book multi-city international itineraries, premium-cabin flights (business and first class), luxury hotels and resorts, villas, cruises and bespoke holiday packages.
* Maximise value for members by optimising reward-point redemptions, card-linked offers and luxury hotel programme benefits such as upgrades, breakfast and late checkout.
* Advise on visas, travel documentation, transit rules, baggage, fare conditions and travel insurance.
* Arrange airport meet-and-assist, lounge access, chauffeur transfers and private car rentals.
* Handle disruptions such as cancellations, delays, missed connections and re-bookings with urgency and calm, including during overseas emergencies at odd hours.

**Lifestyle and concierge**

* Secure reservations at fine-dining and celebrity-chef restaurants in India and abroad, often at short notice.
* Source tickets for sold-out concerts, sporting events, theatre and festivals.
* Book golf rounds, spa and wellness retreats, and private experiences.
* Fulfil gifting, flower and cake delivery, courier and personal-assistant requests, and celebration planning for anniversaries and birthdays.
* Build and use a network of luxury partners and suppliers to deliver what others cannot.

**Member Experience**

* Deliver discreet, polished, personalised service, remembering member preferences and using them proactively.
* Maintain accurate records of every interaction in the CRM and ticketing system.
* Meet service KPIs: first-contact resolution, turnaround time, booking accuracy, CSAT/NPS and quality-audit scores.
* Escalate complaints, service failures and suspicious activity through defined channels.

**Data privacy and security**

* Handle member personal information on a strict need-to-know basis, following R360's privacy and information-security policies and India's DPDP Act 2023.
* Follow only approved, secure payment processes. Never record or share card details, OTPs or identity numbers in notes, chats or emails.
* Complete mandatory training on information security, data privacy, fraud awareness and the code of conduct.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Hospitality or travel background: You have 2–5 years in a customer-facing role, for example at a hotel front office or guest relations desk, in airline or airport services, at a travel agency or OTA, in cabin crew, or on a premium customer service desk.
* Well spoken, with fluent English: You are confident, warm and articulate on the phone and in writing, and comfortable speaking with senior, high-profile customers.
* Quick learner: You pick up new systems, processes and destinations fast. We provide full training on our booking tools and service standards, so prior GDS or booking-system experience is welcome but not required.
* Service attitude: You enjoy solving problems for people, take ownership, and stay calm and polite under pressure.
* Graduate in any discipline: A hotel management or travel and tourism qualification is an advantage.
* Shift flexibility: You are open to rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.

**Why join us**

* Serve one of India's most exclusive cardholder communities through a marquee banking partnership.
* Structured training in luxury service standards, travel systems and global destinations.
* Work with a team that values ownership, initiative and service excellence.

**About Revspot**

Revspot is building AI-native revenue infrastructure for high-ticket B2C businesses.

We build AI agents that qualify leads, make voice calls, schedule meetings, engage customers, assist sales teams and drive real revenue outcomes. Every one of those agents runs on a platform that has to be secure, observable and always up.

We are looking for a Platform Engineer (or Site Reliability Engineer) who writes code and builds the core platform services our product teams depend on. This is not a DevOps role. Deploying to AWS and setting up CI/CD pipelines is table stakes here, not the job.

**What You Will Own**

* Build and run authentication and authorization services: login, SSO/OAuth, API keys, service-to-service auth, roles and permissions.
* Build and manage background workers and job queues: retries, dead-letter handling, scheduling, concurrency and autoscaling.
* Scale systems that handle real-time voice calls, lead pipelines and high-volume APIs: capacity planning, load testing, caching and rate limiting.
* Own domain and network management: DNS, TLS certificates, custom domains for customers, load balancers and edge routing.
* Drive data security: encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, PII handling, access controls and audit trails.
* Own logs, metrics, tracing and alerting so any production issue can be found and fixed fast.
* Manage databases: schema migrations, indexing and query performance, replication, backups, restores and cost.
* Build internal platform tools and libraries that make every engineer faster and safer.
* Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and reliability improvements (SLOs, error budgets, on-call hygiene).
* Take platform projects from problem statement to design to production.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, with real time spent building platform, backend or infrastructure systems.
* Strong coding skills in Python, Go, Node.js or a similar language. You write production services, not just scripts and YAML.
* Hands-on experience with at least a few of these platform areas: auth services, background workers and queues, scaling systems, domain management, data security, logs and monitoring, database management.
* Experience with queues and async systems such as SQS, Redis/BullMQ, Celery, Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Solid understanding of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or similar): performance tuning, migrations, backups and replication.
* Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ELK or SigNoz.
* Good grasp of networking, DNS, TLS and security fundamentals.
* Comfortable with AWS (or another major cloud), Docker and Kubernetes, as tools you use to build the platform.
* Ability to independently design, build and ship production systems.

**Strong Plus**

* Built or owned an auth service, job-queue platform or multi-tenant system used in production.
* Scaled a system through a big jump in traffic, and can explain what broke and how you fixed it.
* Experience with security or compliance work (SOC 2, ISO 27001, data privacy).
* Experience running real-time systems (WebSockets, telephony, streaming) or AI/LLM workloads in production.
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or similar.
* Startup experience where you built platform foundations from scratch.

**What Matters Most**

We are not looking for someone who only knows how to deploy on AWS and build CI/CD pipelines.

We want an engineer who can code and has actually built the platform pieces a product runs on.

You should be able to take a problem such as:

*Our background jobs are backing up during peak call hours, a few are silently failing, and we have no idea which customer is affected. Fix it. "*

…and independently design the queueing, retries, scaling, alerting and dashboards, write the code, and ship it.

**You Will Thrive Here If**

* You enjoy building systems more than clicking through consoles.
* You care about reliability, security and performance as product features.
* You move fast and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
* You like making other engineers more productive.
* You want your work to directly impact real customer and revenue outcomes.
* You want significant ownership early in your career.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Learning Support Assistant to work closely with children with Autism, ADHD, learning disabilities, and other developmental needs in mainstream school settings. In this role, you will serve as a one-on-one educational facilitator for a child, helping them achieve academic, behavioural, and social goals in an inclusive classroom. After approximately six months of successful school-based support, you will also have the opportunity to take on Homecare therapy assignments, providing individualized support to children at home. Insighte provides comprehensive in-house training (including the TEACCH approach and other neurodiversity-affirming methods) to prepare you for both school and home environments, ensuring you are fully equipped before transitioning into any Homecare role.

Key Responsibilities

• In-Class Support: Work as a shadow teacher within a classroom, facilitating the child’s inclusion by adapting lessons and activities to their needs and assisting with attention, communication, and social interaction.

• Home Environment Support: Following the initial period, deliver one-on-one therapeutic or educational sessions in a child’s home environment, reinforcing learning and behavioural strategies in daily routines (with full training provided beforehand).

• Goal Implementation: Collaborate with special educators or Mentors to implement individualized education plans (IEPs) or learning goals for the child, focusing on academic progress, behaviour modification, and social skills development.

• Progress Monitoring: Track the child’s improvements and challenges. Maintain daily notes and prepare monthly progress reports for parents and the Insighte team, highlighting milestones and areas needing adjustment.

• Parent & Teacher Collaboration: Communicate regularly and professionally with parents, teachers, and the Insighte team to ensure consistency in strategies across school and home. Provide guidance to parents on how to support the child’s development at home.

• Inclusive Advocacy: Uphold a child-rights based approach in all interactions, advocating for the child’s needs and inclusion. Help reintegrate the child into mainstream activities by bridging learning or social gaps.

• Professional Development: Attend all required in-house training sessions, workshops, and supervision meetings. Continuously update your skills and apply feedback to improve the child’s support plan.

Qualifications

• Educational Background: Master’s degree in Psychology/ Social work or related field. Additional certification or diploma in Special Education is highly valued.

• Experience: Prior experience or internships working with children (especially those with special needs) is preferred. Understanding of inclusive education practices is a plus.

• Skills: Excellent communication skills (fluency in English is required; proficiency in Hindi/Kannada is a plus). Creativity in approach, patience, and the ability to engage children in learning. Strong observational and reporting skills to document progress.

• Mindset: Passionate about inclusion and child development. A self-starter who is proactive, eager to learn, and adaptable in challenging situations. Empathy, positivity, and professionalism are essential.

• Other Requirements: Ability to commit to at least 1 year in the role to ensure continuity in the child’s progress. Punctuality and reliability in attending sessions (school hours and any scheduled home sessions). Willingness to travel within the city for home assignments if required.

Training & Career Development

At Insighte, you will undergo robust in-house training when you join, equipping you with techniques like the TEACCH method and neurodiversity-affirming practices to confidently support children with special needs. You’ll receive ongoing supervision and mentoring throughout the year to refine your skills. Before taking on any Homecare assignment, you will be provided specialized training and orientation to ensure you can effectively transition to the home environment. This role is designed with growth in mind – as you gain experience, you expand your impact from the school into the home, broadening your expertise in inclusive education and therapy.

Compensation & Benefits

• Remuneration: Starting salary is in the range of ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month during the initial school-based assignment. As you take on additional Homecare sessions alongside shadow teaching, your earning potential can increase up to ₹40,000 per month, reflecting the added responsibilities and client engagements.

• Performance-Based Growth: Insighte follows a client-based pay model where exceptional work and additional client sessions can boost your income. There is no fixed cap on growth – your dedication and the number of assignments you handle drive your earnings.

• Work Schedule: This is a full-time role (typically Monday to Friday day shifts, following school timings for shadow support). Homecare sessions, if assigned, are scheduled in alignment with family needs, with consideration for a balanced workload.

• Professional Development: Access to regular training workshops, webinars, and courses conducted by Insighte to enhance your professional knowledge. Year-round supervision ensures you have guidance and support whenever needed.

• Inclusive Culture: Be part of a young and energetic team that values each member’s insights. We pride ourselves on a friendly, inclusive work environment where your ideas and growth are encouraged. You will have the fulfillment of making a tangible difference in a child’s life and contributing to a more inclusive society every day.

**Why we need this role**
The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (M365, Azure, GCP & Identity) is responsible for the engineering, implementation, and operational support of Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and enterprise identity (AD/Entra).
  
  
The role delivers secure, standardised, and automated solutions, translating architectural designs, standards, and roadmaps into robust, scalable platform implementations and operational services.
  
  
Working as a senior technical expert within the engineering team, the role collaborates with Architecture, Security, Development, and Operations teams to ensure solutions are delivered, integrated, and operated effectively.
  
  
It embeds security, resilience, automation, and operability by implementation, driving consistency and optimisation across M365, Azure, GCP, and Identity platforms. Through engineering excellence, the role reduces risk, complexity, and manual effort, improves resilience and service stability, and supports cost-efficient platform operations.

Engineers and supports solutions across M365, Azure, GCP, and Identity, ensuring platforms, tooling, interfaces, and configurations are secure, resilient, automated, and operationally effective.
  
  

* Microsoft 365 Platforms: Implementation, configuration, and support of collaboration and productivity services (inc. Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune), including governance controls, security settings, and lifecycle activities
* Azure Cloud: Deployment and support of landing zones, subscriptions, connectivity, platform services, and governance controls aligned to architectural standards
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Implementation and operational support of project structures, networking, workload environments, and security configurations
* Identity & Access: Engineering and operation of Active Directory and Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, privileged access, identity governance, and directory integration
* Cloud Security & Compliance: Implementation and maintenance of secure configurations, monitoring, logging, encryption, and policy enforcement across cloud and identity platforms
* Delivers and supports standardisation, automation, tooling, and consistency across cloud, workplace, and identity platforms

**What We're Looking For**

* Solution Engineering & Operation
* Implement and operate infrastructure and platform solutions aligned to architectures, standards, and patterns
* Build, configure, and operate end-to-end cloud, M365, and identity solutions
* Act as senior escalation point for engineering and operational issues
* Security, Resilience & Operability
* Implement and operate secure-by-design configurations
* Ensure resilience, recoverability, monitoring, and operational readiness are delivered and sustained
* Roadmap Execution
* Deliver and operate roadmap initiatives and platform improvements
* Support planning and execution of engineering and operational changes
* Cross-Domain Collaboration
* Work with Architecture, Security, Development, and Infrastructure teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Ensure solutions are tested, transitioned, and fully operational
* Vendor & Technology Engagement
* Work with vendors to support implementation, operation, and issue resolution
* Contribute to platform, tooling, and operational improvements
* Operational Governance & Support
* Ensure solutions align to standards and are maintained through BAU lifecycle
* Support incident, problem, and continuous service improvement activities
* Automation, Standardisation & Optimisation
* Implement and operate automation-first solutions
* Reduce manual effort, technical debt, and complexity
* Improve stability, consistency, and operational efficiency at scale

**Operational Support**

* Participate in an on-call rota for priority incident support

**Leadership & Behavioural Expectations**
Operates as a senior engineer with strong ownership, accountability, and delivery focus.
  
  

* Ownership & Execution: Delivers reliable, secure solutions end-to-end, translating design into high-quality implementation
* Technical Leadership: Acts as SME across cloud, M365, and identity, resolving complex technical challenges
* Collaboration & Influence: Works effectively across teams, contributing to design decisions and stakeholder outcomes
* Adaptability & Improvement: Responds to challenges while driving automation, optimisation, and clear communication

**Qualification**

* Extensive experience in engineering and supporting cloud, workplace, and identity platforms
* Strong expertise across:



* Microsoft 365 configuration, administration, and security
* Azure cloud engineering (deployments, governance, connectivity)
* GCP engineering (projects, networking, security, operations)
* Identity and access (Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication, access control)
* Security configuration and resilience practices
* Automation and operational tooling (PowerShell, scripts, IaC concepts)
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capability
* Experience working in enterprise-scale environments

**What We Offer You**
**Looking to make a mark?**
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
  
  
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
  
  
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
  
  
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion**

* Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

**Benefits**

* Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.

* Lead the end-to-end application packaging lifecycle from requirements gathering through deployment, maintenance, and retirement.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
Introduction
  
  
**Job Title:**
Lead Platform Engineer
  
  
**Overview:**
Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining & Metals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals & Petrochemicals with the state-of-the-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues.
  
  
The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles. You will be key in managing multiple installations of the platform across Cloud and on-premise environments, fixing security vulnerabilities on a monthly basis, conducting audits, and contributing to automation of installations. You will have a great opportunity to work with a world-class team and latest technologies and be able to learn and contribute.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the IRIS Platform operations roadmap and execute planned research and development
* Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS using best practices and governance standards
* Lead production operations, including incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
* Automate so that IRIS Platform is deployable easily across multiple Cloud providers such as Azure and AWS, and on-premise such as K3s and RKE2
* Work with customers and Services team to support multiple installations of the IRIS platform
* Conduct monthly audits including vulnerabilities, DAST tests, and review of backups, cost and access reviews
* Develop CICD pipelines for projects built microservices that would be deployable across multiple environments
* Implement security best practices in cloud and on-premise environments to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements
* Develop and maintain Helm charts for packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications
* Manage operations of the databases and messaging systems Postgres, Elastic, Redis, and Kafka including configuration, scalability, and backups
* Implement auto-scaling of various platform services within the Kubernetes environment
* Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, Ansible, or similar IaC tools
* Operate Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain SLAs and availability targets
* Apply security best practices and enforce compliance standards across cloud and deployment pipelines
* Be the operations contact point for multiple product teams

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure
* 3+ years of experience working with Linux systems
* 4+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
* 2+ years of experience working with Docker
* 4+ years of experience setting up CICD pipelines (AzureDevOps or similar)
* 2+ years of experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
* 2+ years of experience with Cloud such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* Good knowledge of best security practices, vulnerability management, and testing tools such as Acunetix, Snyk, CheckMarx or Trivy
* Troubleshooting problems in Production and comfortable doing root cause analysis
* Able to work in an Agile environment

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications:**

* Good working or operational knowledge of databases (Postgres, Elastic search, Redis or similar)
* Exposure to configuring web servers such as Nginx
* Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus
* Working knowledge of a messaging framework such as Event Hub, Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Flexible hybrid working model
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment
* Access to the latest technologies and tools
* Opportunity to make a tangible impact on cutting-edge Retail/CPG AI solutions

**Diversity & Inclusion Statement:**
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
  
  
**About Us**
SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
**About BiteSpeed**

Hey there! We are a
**Sequoia-backed SaaS startup**
building an AI-native Marketing, Support & Sales suite for e-commerce brands.

We’re currently working with
**2500+ e-commerce brands**
globally across 50+ countries and are fortunate to have
**raised $5.5M+**
along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal & more backing us.

💡
**Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!**

**Check out more about us here**
- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200+ odd 5-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).

**We’ve had some solid investors back us**
(making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway) -

Ecommerce AI startup BiteSpeed raised USD 3.5 million

E-commerce AI start-up BiteSpeed raises $3.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge

BiteSpeed Raises $1.9 Million Seed Funding From Sequoia India's Surge

**About the role**

Some problems at BiteSpeed have a clear owner, a clear process and a clear answer. This role is for the ones that don't.

We're looking for a
**Founder’s Office Intern**
who enjoys figuring things out. You could be working on a market research project in the morning, analysing a business problem in the afternoon and building a simple process or automation by evening. The common thread is that you'll be expected to
**take an ambiguous problem, break it down and make something happen.**

You'll work closely with the founders and leadership team across different parts of the business. This isn't a role where you'll have a neatly defined job description or do the same thing every day. You'll get exposure to
**strategy, operations, product, GTM, AI and whatever else is important to the business at that point in time.**

**What you’ll do**

* Work closely with the founders on
  **high-priority business problems**
  across functions.

* Take ambiguous questions and turn them into
  **structured problems, analyses and actionable next steps**
  .

* Conduct market, customer and competitor research to help the team make better decisions.
* Analyse business data, identify patterns and translate them into insights.

* Build simple processes, systems, dashboards or automations to solve recurring problems.

* Work with different teams across
  **Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success and Operations**
  to get things moving.

* Take ownership of projects from
  **figuring out what needs to be done to actually getting it done**
  .

* Identify bottlenecks and ask, "Why are we doing this manually?" or "Is there a better way to do this?"

* Support strategic projects that could range from
  **new market research to GTM experiments, AI use cases, process improvements and special projects**
  .

* Present your thinking clearly to founders and leadership, including what you found, what you recommend and why.

* Learn fast, switch contexts quickly and get comfortable working on problems where the answer isn't obvious.

**What makes you a good fit**

* You naturally enjoy
  **solving problems**
  . Give you a messy question and your first instinct is to figure out how to break it down.

* You're a
  **generalist at heart**
  . You don't need a perfectly defined function to do good work.

* You're highly curious and enjoy learning about how businesses work.

* You have strong
  **analytical and structured thinking**
  and can work comfortably with numbers and data.

* You have high agency. If something needs to get done, you don't wait around for someone to tell you exactly how.

* You're comfortable saying,
  **"I don't know, but I'll figure it out."**

* You communicate clearly and can put your thoughts into a simple, compelling story.

* You're comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities.

* You care about the quality of your work, but don't get stuck trying to make everything perfect.

* You're excited by startups and would rather have
  **ownership over a problem than a fancy job title**
  .

* Prior experience in startups, consulting, strategy, product, operations, entrepreneurship or similar is a plus, but
  **we care more about how you think than what's on your resume.**

**Salary and Location**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Expected CTC:**
We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

**Our Way Of Life**

Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture - but it ends up becoming more than just that.

It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.

**Our Purpose**

At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create. Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:-

* **Personal Transformation:**
  We like to think of BiteSpeed as being a gym for our careers. It’s where we come to do great work we can be proud of and push ourselves in the pursuit of excellence. Is it comfortable? No. Is it painful? Sometimes. Is it fulfilling? Yes. We were never the company that was supposed to win - We started out of a dorm room, solo founder, early engineers who hadn’t written code in their lives setting out to build a global SaaS company. Our roots are in doing things we are unqualified for and we bet on people who want that journey for themselves. There are stories of people across the company from a 20 year old who’s never done sales closing enterprise deals to a college intern owning an enterprise product lifecycle - these are the stories we are proud of. If someone can look back after 2 years of working at BiteSpeed and say they don’t identify with who they were, we’d call it a success and we want to help them get there.

* **Wealth Creation:**
  Somehow most companies are shy about wanting to make money. It’s looked at as this thing which everyone does but no one really talks about. We’re not ashamed of doing it for the money. Wealth unlocks choice. If life is an amusement park, we think there is value to getting an unlimited rides pass. It's purposeful for us to try to create wealth that allows people to achieve their life's dreams - whether that's owning a house or booking a dream vacation for their parents. We do this by ensuring everyone in the team gets equity and there are generous cash & equity bumps on a frequent basis to reward performance and alignment in values.

* **Winning Together:**
  We’re not here for a participation certificate. We’re playing to win. The keyword here is ‘together’. Winning ‘together’ is about recognising it’s a team sport. We don't care about man of the match awards, either we win the trophy or we don’t. There is a certain camaraderie that comes with winning together that’s hard to explain, but it’s deeply fulfilling and energising. The question we ask ourselves is - can we play the game like it’s never been played before?

**Our Values**

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values. We have 5 core values:-

* **Go Above And Beyond:**
  We value people who care about doing a good job. Going above and beyond is about doing more than the bare minimum that gets the job done and raising the bar each time we have the opportunity to do so

* **Making Things Happen:**
  Each company has an operating rhythm and this is that for us. Making things happen is the opposite of being passive. It’s about high agency, about always believing there is a way to get what we want and either finding the way or making the way

* **Say It Like It Is:**
  We are candid and direct when it comes to sharing feedback, transparent with our numbers and intellectually honest about the realities of any business situation

* **Progress Over Perfection:**
  We’re not building rockets. We care about moving fast and iterating towards perfection. We like to take a minimum viable approach to prioritisation and problem solving and actively look for 80/20 solutions

* **Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously:**
  Great things are built when people can contribute to pursuits beyond themselves. Being low ego, not needing praise to do a good job, taking feedback with humility, being self-critical all add up to this

**Perks & Benefits**

Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning & keep things fun:-

* **Health Insurance**
  - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* **Quarterly Off-sites**
  - Quarterly off-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* **Cult Fitness Membership**
  - All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* **Personal Development**
  - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance**
  - Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

**How to apply?**

If this sounds interesting
**drop a personal note**
with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
**nikita@bitespeed.co**
. Tell us about something you shipped that you’re particularly proud of (could be due to quality or constraints or anything that made it valuable for you).

Know someone who might be a great fit?
**Refer them to us**
, if they end up joining we'll send you an
**Apple Airpods Pro**
as a gesture of thanks!

For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

title: Field Sales Executive - PadCare Housing
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role Overview & Key Responsibilities:**

The Field Sales Executive will drive Padcare’s growth across housing societies in Pune. You’ll lead on-ground outreach, build strong relationships with RWAs and facility teams, and convert communities into long-term partners. Working closely with sales and operations, you’ll ensure smooth onboarding, consistent service, and a great customer experience. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys fieldwork, community engagement, and making a real sustainability impact.

* Drive growth of Padcare Housing (PH) across assigned regions through lead generation, outreach, community engagement, and on-ground campaigns.
* Build relationships with committee members, facility managers, apartment forums, and other key stakeholders.
* Map housing societies, identify high-potential clusters, and execute territory expansion plans.
* Conduct meetings, awareness drives, resident sessions, community events, and regular society visits to improve visibility and conversions.
* Own the end-to-end onboarding of new societies, including bin deployment, awareness, resident communication, and coordination with internal teams.
* Manage day-to-day PH operations, including route planning, pickup schedules, stock requirements, field coordination, and service quality.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, resolve queries and escalations, and support renewals and retention through strong service delivery.
* Maintain accurate sales and operational MIS, including lead trackers, funnel metrics, pickup records, service logs, customer data, and performance dashboards.
* Prepare monthly impact reports highlighting waste diverted, recycling impact, and service performance.
* Track revenue realization, renewals, and account performance while identifying operational and commercial gaps.
* Gather market and competitor insights and recommend strategies for growth and scale.
* Develop and improve SOPs, sales playbooks, and operational processes to enable efficient scaling.

**What we're looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Environmental Science, Business, Sales, etc.).
* 1–3 years of experience in waste management, facility management, sustainability, in the space of housing/apartment/RWA engagement.
* Smart, exceptional Freshers welcome.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Proactive, quick learner with a hustler mindset.
* Comfortable with extensive intra- and inter-city travel.
* Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace; basic CRM knowledge preferred.
* Culture Fit: Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode: Full time; Pune based; Extensive Field travel required.**

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
   Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives
* **Growth Path:**
   Opportunity to scale into Business Development Manager and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
   Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
   Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.​
